title: EU Cookie Law 3.0.1: Cookie message does not go away
body:
- WordPress 4.9.6
- WP Rocket 3.0.5-beta1
- EU Cookie Law 3.0.1

EU Cookie Law set up with default settings, only checked the _Activate_ option.

Cookie message gets added on the front-end; **should go away after a click on the _Ok_ button, but doesn’t.**

Activating the _Auto Block_ option in EU Cookie Law fixes the issue. However, since we say WP Rocket supports this third-party plugin, we should fix this on our end.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Apparently, it’s not always the _Auto Block_ option only. User feedback:

> With just _Auto Block_ enabled, the problem persists. 
> However, when I check _Excluded scripts(/beta)_, the banner disappears on click.

_[(ticket reference)](https://secure.helpscout.net/conversation/591613128/70010?folderId=714999)_

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Tested with `EU Cookie Law 3.1.6` and WP Rocket 3.10.6, the message goes away correctly.
